cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives; funding_interval_hours converted to Nautilus minutes
cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged the configured 6 bp rate. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop-market execution reserves the shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding hour. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding rates and uses adaptive bar ordering.
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding 60 minutes, minimum one tick; independent of signal direction and outcome.

description: Shared-account causal external-liquidity auction router: initiative acceptance continuation or failed-auction reversal

validation_protocol.detector_scenario_separation: Completed external-liquidity interactions are first detected, then routed to one of two explicit trade scenarios. No outcome data enters either detector.
validation_protocol.entry: Market OUO bracket submitted only after the completed ten-second scenario confirmation bar.
validation_protocol.execution_causality: A normal position close must occur strictly after the recorded entry fill timestamp; same-timestamp entry/exit is an implementation failure.
validation_protocol.failed_auction_reversal: Outward acceptance is reclaimed through the completed boundary; a separate inward aggressive-flow bar must break the reclaim-bar extreme; stop is beyond the observed sweep extreme; target is the nearest active completed opposite-side external level.
validation_protocol.funding: Official archive funding settlements and completed mark prices are injected into NautilusTrader; only already-observed funding state enters sizing.
validation_protocol.global_selection: At any timestamp only the highest causal cost-after net reward-risk signal is eligible; while any order or position exists all other assets are unavailable.
validation_protocol.initiative_acceptance_continuation: Outward aggressive-flow acceptance; boundary-holding retest without an artificial contraction requirement; separate same-direction reacceleration; confirmation close must clear at least one shifted causal 60-minute ten-second true-range Q99 noise reserve beyond the boundary.
validation_protocol.promotion: The fixed first Nautilus week must pass before the other two fixed weeks. All three must then meet the screen gate before any long evaluation.
validation_protocol.sizing: Current full shared USDT NAV times 3 percent divided by expected entry-to-stop loss including two 6 bp fill charges, one adverse entry tick, shifted causal Q99 stop-slippage reserve, and causal funding reserve; actual funding is settled in NAV.
validation_protocol.target: Nearest active completed 4-hour/day/week external level; no fitted R fallback.
